title: Emergency Communications Plan
description: Sets out a communication hierarchy for congested cell networks, cell outages, and total electronic failure, with an out-of-area contact, check-in protocol, and family code word. Covers NOAA, FRS/GMRS, ham, and CB radio, visual and sound signals, location-specific plans, an equipment checklist, and a monthly drill.
shortDescription: A tiered family plan for congested, down, and fully failed networks
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
